name: memory-recall
description: Turn 1 asks the agent to record a project fact so that a future session picks it up. Turn 2 is a separate process with a fresh session and asks for that fact back.
proves: durable project memory across sessions — that the agent writes the fact into the instruction file the context engine loads (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md), and that a cold session actually reads it back. Two separate processes, so nothing survives in memory.
